friction: No browser, so nothing was seen: every 'yes' is a green build, a server render of the first paint and reading. What cost time: (1) ContextMenu gives items(target) an element and says 'one area around a list serves every row' but not how to get the row's key from it; one line naming data-key would do. (2) ListItem cannot cut a long name in a fluid list; a min-w-0 on its text column, or a truncate prop, would. (3) Tree and ListItem take drag and drop hooks but draw no drop-target state; I had to write the tint and outline, with bg-primary/8 copied from DropZone. (4) Nothing says what happens when a droppable GridList sits inside a DropZone, the natural shape of a file browser; a sentence in DropZone's comment would settle it. (5) DropZone's 'bare' variant is only in the type's comment, not in the component's. (6) A selecting ButtonGroup's children (isToggle + id) and Menu's entry type needed the source. (7) A file tile for a grid: GridListItem's comment mentions Card, I did not check it and wrote the tile. ds-build's table of what comes straight from React Aria (useDragAndDrop, Virtualizer) was exactly what was needed and saved the most time.
